description: ODR-DabMod is provided by Opendigitalradio. ODR-DabMod is Opendigitalradio's DAB modulator within the ODR-mmbTools suite. It reads ETI or EDI and produces COFDM in-phase and quadrature samples, supports the four DAB transmission modes and documents timing for single-frequency networks.
